name: Endou Makiko
source:
The president of a famous company. 

A very rich woman has the money to get everything she wants. She was saved by Arahama while walking through the city, a fact that made her fall madly in love with him.

Makiko is not married, in fact, she has never had a boyfriend or had sex before, she decided to give her virginity to Arahama to check if they were compatible, a matter that she verified and agreed to become his sex friend.

Upon hearing Arahama's marriage, she blocked the appeal of the other heroines but began to seduce himself with her money and her body.

SEX preference: Creampies, Bondage. [spoiler]Be treated with love and kindness[/spoiler].

"Puff, housework isn't a big deal. Just hire one of those servants. At least I can give him more than just normal life."
